tilts.set: SET on 2026-11-13 by the Portfolio Fitness for Fighting judg

industry.why: Double Underweight, carried, with the first European consumer readings in six weeks on its side and the tape's disagreement narrower. German consumer confidence (GfK) reads -30.8 for November from -30.6 and the euro area's flash reads -17.9 for October from -16.5 (Newsquawk, undated): low and edging lower, so the condition 'to D on a European consumer reading that is not falling' is tested and not met. The United States reading is disputed (University of Michigan 51.0, a three-month high, 6 November, against outlets describing it as falling). Relative strength, 2026-11-13 against 2026-09-11, not week on week: D now, D prior at the industry (C at last week's reading), with Online retail A, Hotels B (A last week), Apparel B and Physical retail B, so the second condition (the industry at C or better with Hotels and Online retail holding A) is not met either. Component 1 regime, 13-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its 52-week high, still present on Richard's European test and weakening at the margin for the first time: breadth up a third week to 66%, 60%, 62% and 63% of stocks above the 50, 100, 150 and 200-day averages, the three longer ones still below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, cyclicals ahead of defensives over one week and twelve months while defensives lead at four weeks, three months and six months; the causes unread by any reasoned source for a second week, web headlines only, and the headlines lean against the rates squeeze of the 30-Oct-26 read: the Federal Reserve easing, oil below $100). Counter-case: the survey readings are undated headlines, four sectors still read A or B, 20 Pool stocks sit under this letter, and cyclicals led over the last week. To D on a European consumer reading that is not falling, or the industry back at C with Online retail holding A.

sector.why: Underweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 9-Oct-26 (late-cycle rates squeeze turning into a European credit-and-sovereign stress episode: hiking path re-marked up, credit joined rates, French spread 152 basis points, European breadth at three-year lows on all four averages, index 5.3% off its high, defensives turning over one and four weeks but unconfirmed, growth firm at the level; sources present 2026-W41): big-ticket consumer purchases financed at higher rates under a low United States consumer reading; the turning note's falling side has the premium carmakers and suppliers as its widest group (seven of 25 failing the negative test, BMW and Mercedes-Benz each minus 15 points relative over 20 days), with autos not spoken to by any source. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-09 against 2026-08-07, not week on week: F now, F prior. Held at D, not F, because the evidence for a second notch is a brainstorm and because the MI Pool holds no name in this row. Counter-case: the strongest balance sheets are first to be right-sized and first to recover.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried on a reading now three weeks stale, said plainly: the French premium (a record 150 basis points on 26 October) was not re-read; the one item this week is an undated headline that France's debt risks keep bond investors on edge (Investing Live), which agrees in direction and gives no level, so the conditions (to D under 120 basis points for a month; to C under 100) could not be tested. Component 1 regime, 13-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its 52-week high, still present on Richard's European test and weakening at the margin for the first time: breadth up a third week to 66%, 60%, 62% and 63% of stocks above the 50, 100, 150 and 200-day averages, the three longer ones still below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, cyclicals ahead of defensives over one week and twelve months while defensives lead at four weeks, three months and six months; the causes unread by any reasoned source for a second week, web headlines only, and the headlines lean against the rates squeeze of the 30-Oct-26 read: the Federal Reserve easing, oil below $100). 15 Pool stocks are French-listed. Counter-case: a top-letter country view held three weeks without a spread reading is the row most at risk of being simply out of date. Re-test when the premium is read; if it is unread for a fourth week the row goes to D on staleness alone.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
